_doc: Product claims that pages may make (blueprint gate 9). Each claim maps to a line in the app repo at the pinned commit. gate.py checks that the file line holds the proof when the app repo is on this machine. Reason for no prices: offerings.ts holds only the offering id; amounts live in RevenueCat, so pages say 'Plans and prices are in the app'.

app_note.text: The InvoiceSnap app saves customers and past invoices.
It records payments that you get outside the app.
It drafts estimate lines from a job description with optional online AI, and you review each draft.
The free plan has 3 invoices and 3 estimates in total, not per month.
Plans and prices are in the app.
The form on this page has fields that the app does not have, such as a service date.

tool_facts.text: The form runs in your browser and makes the files on your device.
tool_facts.proof: src/static/assets/tool.js and the gate_browser.py network check

tool_facts.text: The files are PDF, Word and Excel, not an e-invoice format.
